entries.subject: Placement
entries.finding: Gaia DR3 source 2658974606111711488: position at J2016.0. Distance: McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 114971: distance 42.301 pc, the paper's parallax inverted (Gaia DR1's where it revised the star's, else the Hipparcos reduction of van Leeuwen 2007; section 2.3; fractional uncertainty 0.008), at which the luminosity and radius hold (https://doi.org/10.1093/mnras/stx1433): 42.301 +/- 0.338 pc; Gaia DR3 parallax 24.1958 +/- 0.2967 mas (same row, RUWE 2.84), 81.5 standard errors, is not used. Proper motion: Gaia DR3 (same row): 759.268, 17.568 mas/yr. Radial velocity from SIMBAD's radial velocity for Gaia DR3 2658974606111711488 (quality A), from 2018A&A...615A..31D; Gaia DR3 measures none.

entries.subject: Radius, mass and temperature
entries.finding: Radius 11.028 solar radii from McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 114971: radius 11.028 solar radii, implied by the fitted luminosity 62.783 solar luminosities (fractional uncertainty 0.052) and temperature (https://doi.org/10.1093/mnras/stx1433). No mass is measured, so GM is 0, the records' unpublished value. Temperature 4896 +/- 125 K from McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 114971: effective temperature 4896 +/- 125 K, from the fit of a model atmosphere to the star's spectral energy distribution (goodness of fit Q 0.04).
